description.value: Songhees Events & Catering is an Indigenous-owned catering and event company operated by the Songhees Nation in Victoria, BC, offering West Coast menus featuring house-made bannock, candied salmon, and locally inspired dishes. The operation includes on-site event space at the Songhees Wellness Centre, off-site catering, and a food truck. A touring cyclist venturing here would encounter a distinctive taste of Coast Salish food culture.

address.value: 1100 Admirals Rd, Victoria, BC V9A 2P6, Canada

bike_parking_detail: 2 racks within 100m: rack at 59m; rack (8 spaces) at 66m. Total: 8 spaces.
